name: io.github.arminazimi/seaworthy
title: Seaworthy
description: Verifies built static sites for agents: check metadata, full-site and changed-file reports as JSON.

environmentVariables.name: SEAWORTHY_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: Path to a Chrome or Chromium binary. Used only by the opt-in rendered checks; without it the server reads no site from the network and launches no browser.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.note: Staged in the repository, not yet publishable: @seaworthy/mcp (and @seaworthy/verify, which it depends on) is not on npm and the @seaworthy scope is not claimed, so the registry's package-ownership check cannot pass. Every value here mirrors this repository today: the name, title and version the MCP server reports in its initialize handshake, the stdio transport it connects, and the package name it will be published under.
